---
applyTo: "docs/**,README.md"
---

## Documentation rules
- Prefer targeted edits
- Keep language concrete and implementation-aligned
- Reference commands, file paths, and code artifacts accurately
- Mark uncertain or future behavior explicitly
- When changing a manual in `docs/manuals/`, bump `VERSION` and `DATE` in its build
  script and rebuild the `.docx` in the same commit — see the manual versioning rule
  in `AGENTS.md`
